slots.jd.distribution.about:
Position summary
Beacon Distribution Group seeks a Transportation Supervisor to oversee daily driver and fleet operations at its Kansas City distribution site. The Transportation Supervisor directs drivers, works closely with dispatch, and ensures that loads move safely, on schedule and in compliance with applicable regulations. Minimum requirements include commercial driving experience and prior supervisory responsibility. Experience with hazardous materials freight is preferred.
slots.jd.distribution.duties:
Responsibilities
- Supervise the securing and checking of loads before trucks leave the facility.
- Coordinate with dispatch on driver assignments, departure times and route changes.
- Review and maintain driver logs to confirm accurate hours-of-service records.
- Confirm that drivers complete vehicle inspections and report defects promptly.
- Train and coach drivers on safe operating practices and company procedures.
- Resolve delivery issues with dispatch and customers as they arise.
slots.jd.distribution.needs:
Minimum and preferred qualifications
- Minimum: 15 or more years of commercial driving and transportation experience.
- Minimum: Demonstrated hours-of-service logging, route planning and pre-trip inspections.
- Minimum: Experience with hazmat handling and delivery scheduling.
- Minimum: Working knowledge of dispatch software.
- Required certification: Dispatch Coordinator Certificate.
- Preferred: Experience with cargo documentation and fuel and mileage logs.
slots.r1.b1: Coordinates trailer swaps with dispatch and oversees trailer coupling checks in the yard, cutting departure delays by 20 percent.
slots.r1.b2: Trains new drivers on cargo documentation, walking each new hire through load paperwork before they run routes on their own.
slots.r1.b3: Leads load securement and inspection checks and reviews hours-of-service logging for each shift, reducing load-related exceptions by 30 percent.
slots.r1.b4: Maintains driver logs and reviews them against defensive driving practices, following up with drivers when entries show unsafe patterns.
slots.r1.b5: Enforces pre-trip inspections before each dispatch, raising on-time customer deliveries by 45 percent.
slots.r1.i1: Supervises transportation operations at Tidewater Haulers, working with dispatch each day to match loads with drivers and trailers.
slots.r1.i2: Oversees defect reporting at Tidewater Haulers, making sure drivers flag vehicle problems and repairs are completed before trucks return to service.
slots.r2.b1: Applied route planning to long-haul runs, reducing average delivery transit time by 25 percent.
slots.r2.b2: Reported vehicle defects promptly during hazmat handling assignments, keeping hazardous loads off the road until repairs were cleared.
slots.r2.b3: Built driver schedules and routes from fuel and mileage logs, cutting empty miles by 45 percent.
slots.r2.b4: Performed pre-trip vehicle inspections with a focus on trailer coupling, confirming fifth wheel and air line connections before departure.
slots.r2.b5: Coordinated with dispatch on load status and kept cargo documentation complete, lowering paperwork-related delivery holds by 30 percent.
slots.r2.i1: Drove senior routes for Granite Ridge Transport and reported vehicle defects to maintenance so trucks were repaired before their next assignment.
slots.r2.i2: Served as a senior driver at Granite Ridge Transport, training new drivers on safe operation, inspections and paperwork while running a full route schedule.
slots.r3.b1: Kept hours-of-service logging accurate on each shift, planning breaks around delivery windows and improving on-time customer deliveries by 10 percent.
slots.r3.b2: Planned routes around traffic, weather and road conditions, applying defensive driving to keep deliveries safe and steady.
slots.r3.b3: Completed pre-trip inspections and reported vehicle defects to maintenance, reducing roadside breakdowns by 50 percent.
slots.r3.b4: Checked brakes, tires, lights and fluids during pre-trip vehicle inspections and used route planning to set departure times.
slots.r3.b5: Coordinated with dispatch on hazmat handling requirements for each load, cutting delays at receiving docks by 30 percent.
slots.r3.i1: Operated Class A tractor-trailers for Stonebridge Logistics, completing pre-trip vehicle inspections before each run.
slots.r3.i2: Drove freight routes for Stonebridge Logistics, planning each route around delivery windows, road restrictions and safe stopping points.
slots.summary.1: Transportation supervisor with 15 years in commercial driving and dispatch, leading a driver team and answering for its safety, on-time delivery and compliance results. Brings hands-on strength in cargo documentation, trailer coupling, defensive driving, route planning and hazmat handling, backed by a Commercial Driver Licence with Hazardous Materials Endorsement.
slots.summary.2: Lead-level truck driving and dispatch professional with 15 years of experience, now supervising transportation operations and owning the results of the driver program. Trains drivers in defensive driving, trailer coupling and cargo documentation, and holds the Dispatch Coordinator Certificate and Driver Safety Certificate.
